site: Example bench (a New Era syringe pump)
notes: An example overlay, not a statement about any pump.  The driver refuses every write of the pumping volume and of the pumping rate (MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET) until the operator states the range its syringe allows; this file shows the shape of that overlay.  The example ranges describe a bench with a 10 mL syringe used between 0.1 and 10 mL and between 0.1 and 25 mL/min.

pumping_volume_ml.reason: example: the syringe fitted on this bench holds 10 mL and volumes below 0.1 mL are not used

pumping_rate_ml_per_min.reason: example: this bench pumps between 0.1 and 25 mL/min
